beats.headline: Donating to the war effort
beats.text: Ren sits down heavily on the scorched, broken tiles beside Garret, unsnaps her flamethrower attachment and lets the whole apparatus topple; she was really looking forward to torching some of those assholes on the next floor. There is one key left, and she will not fight Carl and Donut for it. She kicks the flamethrower at Carl. Take it, she says, take it all, fast, and rings, clothes, potions and scrolls appear on the floor. She is donating to the war effort. Her flamethrower is named Velma, by the way. She did not name it.

beats.headline: Among the best prizes
beats.text: Carl makes a quick inventory of everything looted from Quan and from Ren, though he cannot examine it properly until a saferoom. So far the best prizes look like the Eye in the Sky scrolls, the magical tomes, Velma the Flame Thrower and Quan's celestial cloak. It is, Carl realises, the loot Quan took off the crawlers he killed, and the least Carl can do is make certain it is put to good use.

beats.headline: This won't do
beats.text: Shi Maria has control of Carl's body, and she goes through his inventory for what she needs. An empty beaker from the first floor appears, with a sliver of toraline root placed inside. Then she examines Ren's flamethrower, and rejects it: no, no, this won't do. She pulls up his magic menu instead, warns everyone to step back, and casts Self-Immolation, which burns a hole through the floor and leaves the beaker bubbling with black ink.

beats.headline: Under the hammerhead
beats.text: On the line at the edge of the woods, shields glowing up and down it, Jamal bounces on his new legs, excited to battle with his upgrades, and lets a little burst of flame out of the new attachment on his underbelly. It is Velma, Tserendolgor's flamethrower. Rosetta's team in the crafting room has modified it to fit his harness. Please excuse Jamal and Velma, he says. Carl tells him to be careful with that thing, and Jamal promises to flame only on purpose from now on.

beats.headline: Into the honeycombs
beats.text: Hunter seekers come in silently, automatons with no dots on the map, and they are going to explode. Shields up, Carl calls, falling back. Jamal is firing his flamethrower, Jamal announces from his position up in the honeycombs, and he roars and fires, a gout of flame filling the enclosed space. An alarm klaxon starts in broken bursts as the shark moves across the honeycomb and fires into a different hole, then another.

beats.headline: Through the arena
beats.text: In the arena the tenth-floor vehicles are in play, upgraded to the max, and it is a demolition derby. Jamal's Tundra lies in a smoking heap where it crashed into the wall. Jamal jumps through the arena with his flamethrower roaring, landing on monsters and snapping them in half, while Samantha sits right on his head, also screaming a war cry.
